notes: PHP 8.2 + Apache serves the app from public/ on port 3000; MySQL 8 holds the data. The db-init service creates the schema (and adds any columns an older database is missing) and seeds the demo catalogue before the web service starts. Crypto payments are self-hosted: the owner's wallet addresses and USD rates live in the settings table and are edited in Admin -> Settings, so no third-party payment credentials are required. Downloads are resolved from Modrinth (open API, no credentials) or CurseForge (needs CURSEFORGE_API_KEY) links managed in Admin -> Download sources.

secrets.name: CURSEFORGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. CurseForge API key from https://console.curseforge.com/ (API Keys). Only needed for the CurseForge half of Admin -> Download sources; Modrinth works without it and the app boots either way.
